top_concerns: Context term trains on the same forget-set (question, gold context) pairs used for Contextual QA evaluation; no held-out generalization (new questions, contexts, noisy RAG)
Forgetting evidence is weak: Direct QA only, no TOFU Forget Quality, probing or relearning attacks; KL anchor to the original model may reintroduce forgotten knowledge
lambda_c and epoch selected post hoc on evaluation metrics; no seeds, variance or validation split
Missing simple baselines (CE/SFT on contextual prompts, contextual data in retain set, KL vs CE ablation); only 3 of 6 methods fixed
Only TOFU (synthetic) with two models; binary Claude LLM-judge not validated; modest novelty
